about_the_game:
HRROR — a psychological horror about a liminal space that has taken the shape of an office complex.

The player explores labyrinthine corridors and time-frozen rooms, finds key items, and solves puzzles. Each solution brings them closer to liberation.

The main threat is the Job Application Form — a massive, distorted sheet of paper drifting through the hallways. An encounter with it will inevitably result in employment.
